name: Junction
source:
Alise, a working witch who helps people work with old contracts with entities, just had a tough day, but she meets a recent acquaintance by happenstance on the way home. Or was it by design...?

[From [url=https://garbledmess.itch.io/junction]Itch.io[/url]]
